column7: DeleteAuditLogsBefore (audit retention purge) deleted WHERE event_time < cutoff; when id order and event_time order disagree across the cutoff (concurrent writers, HA clock skew) it removed a row from the middle (or tail) of the ADR-029 hash chain, and verify-audit then reported tampering. Fixed by deleting only the contiguous id prefix of rows older than the cutoff, under the KEYAUDIT serialization the append path uses (INV-STORE-22); Postgres variant TestDeleteAuditLogsBefore_InvertedPair_Postgres (pg-gated)
